description:
Read one schema proposal by its ID: title, description, status, author, the source variant, and the proposal variant with the ID of its latest launch.
Also returns the latest revision (its ID, summary, schema check, and launch), every review with its decision and comment, and whether the source variant changed since the proposal was created.
The write tools for a proposal take the graph ID and the proposal variant name from this response.
ReviewProposal and AddProposalComment take latestRevision.id, and PublishProposalRevision takes backingVariant.latestLaunch.id as previousLaunchId.
Provide the proposal ID, which GetProposals returns.
name: GetProposal
